chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Hammad from Imran al-Halabi said:
A man doubts while he is standing, so he does not know if he bowed or not. He (the Imam) said, 'Let him bow.'
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they doubt whether they have bowed during prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides a practical resolution for doubt (*shakk*) occurring during the standing (*qiyam*) position by instructing the worshipper to perform the bowing (*ruku'*). This ruling reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle of favoring the more likely state or ensuring the completeness of obligatory acts when uncertainty arises, distinguishing it from other doubt scenarios where one might return to a previous pillar. It highlights the flexibility within Shia fiqh to maintain prayer validity without excessive burden on the worshipper.
